changelog:
v1.15.0 Netcode Fairness & Idempotency Fixes:
• Idempotent ranked awards — no more double points from a single win
• Server-side ELO/history for Slime Volleyball (was missing entirely)
• Smooth remote slime rendering via 2-snapshot interpolation buffer
• Net-boundary clamp prevents slime-over-pole visual glitches
• Result banner stays until YOU dismiss it — opponent can't wipe it
• Replaced setInterval sync with rAF-cadence emission (fixes tab-throttle snap-back)
• Fixed-timestep accumulator consistency across all games
• RTT quality indicator (green/yellow/red) in game headers
• Match generation counters prevent award replays on rematch
